title: Raycast button
description: A small light keycap button: a 36px rounded rectangle in the primary colour with a dark label, an icon before it, a 2px dark ring, a soft outer glow and thin inset highlights. On hover it turns pure white; pressed, it sinks 1px.
notes: best on dark themes (the button is the brightest thing on the page)
sizes: md (36px) and sm (32px, inside the header)
name: raycast-button

props.name: icon
props.description: a small icon before the label (lucide or a glyph)

props.name: size
props.description: md is the page button, sm lives in the header bar
